title: clearfelt detect.mjs report output
description: Documents the JSON scripts/detect.mjs prints in --mode report (single-file case). This is documentation and a target for scripts/lint.mjs's checkOutputShape(), not a file clearfelt reads or a generic JSON-Schema validator this repo runs (dependency-free, per CLAUDE.md): a model reading this output over Bash has no schema validation between the two, so a real shape drift here would silently confuse the model rather than fail loudly, which is what checkOutputShape() exists to catch instead. --mode score returns only { target, score }; --mode scan returns { target, occurrences }; a directory target wraps this shape once per file under a top-level { target, isDirectory: true, score, files: [...] }. See scripts/lib/report.mjs's runFile() for the actual construction.

target.description: Absolute path to the file scored.

leadDriver.description: Human-readable label for breakdown.impacts[0], or a fallback string when no single factor dominates.

impacts.description: Sorted by magnitude descending, zero-impact rows omitted.
